title: xrouiw Auto Grindstone
description: Automatically removes enchantments from all items in your inventory — including enchanted books. Just open a grindstone and press U!
body:
# xrouiw's Auto Grindstone

Tired of manually removing enchantments one by one? 
Open a grindstone, press **U**, and let it handle everything automatically — including enchanted books!

---

## ✨ Features

- **One-key automation** — Press U to start, press U again to stop
- **Enchanted book support** — Works on all enchanted items, not just equipment
- **Instant mode** — Blazing fast processing
- **Auto button** — Optional button on the grindstone screen
- **Lightweight** — Client-side only, no server needed

---

## 🎮 How to Use

1. Open a grindstone
2. Make sure the input slots are **empty** and you're **not holding anything**
3. Press **U** to start
4. All enchanted items in your inventory will be processed automatically
5. Press **U** again at any time to stop

---

## ⚙️ Config

Open the config screen to toggle:
- **Instant Mode** — Process items as fast as possible
- **Show Button** — Display the Auto button on the grindstone screen

---

## 📋 Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

---

## 📜 Credits

This mod is based on the original **[Auto Grindstone](https://modrinth.com/mod/auto-grindstone)** by **Eri**, 
released under the **CC0-1.0** license.

Huge thanks to Eri for creating the original mod — this wouldn't exist without their work! 🙏

**Changes made in this fork:**
- Added enchanted book support (StoredEnchantments component)
- Rewrote automation logic using QUICK_MOVE for stability and speed
- Updated for Minecraft 1.21.11 API changes

---

*Part of the **xrouiw Auto Series** — automating the boring stuff, one mod at a time.*
